lines.text: Many learners say: I passed two days at home.
Better: I spent two days at home.
Spent! I spent two hours on it.

data.wrong: I passed two days at home.
data.right: I spent two days at home.

quiz.stem: I ___ two hours on this video.

native.tip: Em português dizemos “passei dois dias em casa”; em inglês, para tempo, o natural é “spend”: “I spent”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “I passed two days at home.” O certo é “I spent two days at home.” Aqui o “passar” não funciona: em inglês o tempo é gasto, “spend”. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “spent”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: For time, the natural English verb is “spend”: “I spent two days at home”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “I passed two days at home.” The right way is “I spent two days at home.” Here “passar” does not work: in English time is “spent”. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
